upcomingSchedules.title: Upcoming Scheduled Workouts
upcomingSchedules.emptyDesc: Schedule a routine on your calendar to plan ahead.
upcomingSchedules.tooltipDesc: Upcoming workouts scheduled on the calendar by you or assigned by your coach.
upcomingSchedules.tooltipCalc: Scheduled workouts where scheduledAt >= today AND status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'RESCHEDULED')
upcomingSchedules.tooltipLimit: Completed sessions move to your training log.

analyticsView.title: Personal Training Analytics & Telemetry
analyticsView.subtitle: In-depth progression curves, training volume, and consistency breakdown
analyticsView.bottomPrompt: Looking for individual workout set records or physique progress?
analyticsView.volumeActivityTooltipDesc: Total weight tonnage lifted per day (past 30 days) or per month (past 12 months).
analyticsView.volumeActivityTooltipCalc: SUM(reps × weight_kg) for all completed sets within each date interval
analyticsView.volumeActivityTooltipLimit: Days with 0 kg indicate rest days or non-weightlifting routines.
analyticsView.durationTrendTooltipDesc: Average active workout duration in minutes per day across the past 30 days.
analyticsView.durationTrendTooltipCalc: SUM(duration) / COUNT(sessions) on each calendar date
analyticsView.durationTrendTooltipLimit: Zero-padded on days where no workout session was completed.
analyticsView.sessionStatusTooltipDesc: Proportion of your workout sessions by final operational status: Completed, In Progress, or Cancelled.
analyticsView.sessionStatusTooltipCalc: SUM(sessions) grouped by status / total sessions × 100
analyticsView.sessionStatusTooltipLimit: Cancelled sessions record abandoned workouts; in progress denotes active sessions.
analyticsView.noSessionHistory: No workout session history recorded yet.
analyticsView.startWorkoutToSeeDistribution: Start a workout to see your completion distribution.
analyticsView.weeklyOutputTooltipDesc: Total number of completed sets or unique exercises performed each week.
analyticsView.weeklyOutputTooltipCalc: SUM(sets) or COUNT(exercises) grouped by calendar week
analyticsView.weeklyOutputTooltipLimit: Highlights progressive overload and overall training consistency across weeks.
analyticsView.sessionsByDayTooltipDesc: Frequency distribution of workout sessions started across each day of the week (Sun–Sat).
analyticsView.sessionsByDayTooltipCalc: COUNT(sessions) grouped by day of week
analyticsView.sessionsByDayTooltipLimit: Helps identify your preferred workout days vs recovery days.
analyticsView.sessionsByTimeTooltipDesc: Frequency distribution of workout sessions started across different hours of the day.
analyticsView.sessionsByTimeTooltipLimit: Assumes sessions logged in the gym's local timezone.

activityView.title: Training Activity History
activityView.subtitle: Verified chronological timeline of workouts finished and coaching assignments received
activityView.noMatchFallback: Your completed workouts and coaching assignments will appear here.

currentAssignment.noActiveProgramDesc: You don't have an active program yet. Build a custom personal routine or explore the exercise library to start training.
currentAssignment.alreadyActiveResuming: You already have an active workout. Resuming your session.

header.title: Coach Dashboard
header.subtitle: Everything that needs your attention today.

tooltips.activeMembersDesc: Number of members connected to you with an active coaching relationship.
tooltips.activeMembersCalc: COUNT(CoachMemberRelationship WHERE trainerId = coach.id AND status = 'ACTIVE')
tooltips.activeMembersLimit: Excludes pending invitations, terminated relationships, or unassigned members.
tooltips.pendingInvitesDesc: Invitations sent to prospective members that have not yet been accepted or declined.
tooltips.pendingInvitesCalc: COUNT(CoachMemberRelationship WHERE trainerId = coach.id AND status = 'PENDING')
tooltips.pendingInvitesLimit: Updated immediately when members accept or decline.
tooltips.sessionsWeekDesc: Total verified workout sessions completed by your coached and assigned members over the last 7 days.
tooltips.sessionsWeekCalc: COUNT(WorkoutSession WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND startedAt >= weekAgo AND memberId IN roster)
tooltips.expiringDesc: Workout program assignments scheduled to conclude within the next 7 days.
tooltips.expiringCalc: COUNT(Assignment WHERE trainerId = coach.id AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND endDate <= now + 7d)
tooltips.expiringLimit: Allows proactive review and program renewal.
